content.text:
Okay, glasses on. Starting from the right.

- Big word at the top: "מקור". I've never heard that name. It isn't a bank.
- "להבין חיסכון והשקעה בישראל, עם מקור לכל מספר." Fine, "חיסכון" is a word I know, so I'll go on.
- Under it, in smaller letters: "אתר אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק". So it's one person's site, not a company. They say they don't want to sell me anything. Hm. But I don't know who that person is.
- The right half below that is empty and black. Everything else is over on the left. Strange.
- On the left: "מה ראיתם באפליקציה, בפרסומת או בדוח?" and a box that says "הדביקו שם של מוצר". I don't know the name of my bank's savings plan, so I have nothing to paste.
- "להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה". "כמה זה עולה". That's my question, whether the bank takes too much.
- Buttons: "קרן השתלמות", "קופת גמל להשקעה", "קרן כספית", "פיקדון", "חשבון ניירות ערך", "חיסכון לכל ילד". "פיקדון" is mine. It's the last button, at the far left. "קרן כספית" I don't know, so I skip it.
- "מה חברה מציעה לי". Company products. Not for me.
- "מה האתר עוד לא מכסה" and the line about laws: I read the heading and didn't go further.
- The footer at the bottom is small. "פרמטרים", "העברה למכשיר אחר"? No idea.

That's the whole screen. The page gives no answer itself. At most I would press "פיקדון".

**What I'd tell my son:**
"I didn't decide anything, and I'm not moving any money because of this site. I'd ask you to look at it with me. It's calm and it doesn't open with shares or English letters, which is good. There's a 'פיקדון' button and a line promising to explain 'כמה זה עולה', which is exactly my question. But on the screen itself there isn't a single word about whether there's something as safe as a deposit that pays more, or about what the bank takes. It says 'אתר אישי'. Whose? I don't know who's behind it, so I wouldn't trust it with money decisions.

What I read: the title and the line under it, then the savings box with the buttons, then 'מה חברה מציעה לי'. I only saw the heading 'מה האתר עוד לא מכסה'. The footer I skipped because it was small.

The black background made the grey letters hard to read even enlarged: the line under the title, the small line about the laws, and the footer. 'קרן כספית', 'מסלול', 'פרמטרים' and 'העברה למכשיר אחר' meant nothing to me. I didn't get tired, there was only one screen. But I'd want a big line at the top saying who wrote this, and something like 'יש לכם פיקדון? התחילו כאן' in big letters on the right, where I start reading."
